script.spokenHook: The market is flat, but XRP is currently pushing its daily high.
segmentLines: The price rose over 4% today to reach $1.54, leading the top ten coins in gains.

script.takeaway: Trading near the daily high on treasury news
script.cta: Is this a real breakout or just a local top? Tell me below and follow for the next move.
script.title: XRP hits $1.540 while market stalls on public treasury news 📈 #Shorts
